notes.title: Slimefrog Beta Playtest Release!
notes.notes:
[h1][u]The Slimefrog Beta Playtest has just been released![/u][/h1]

This gives you access to the whole game, and all its features for a limited time.

[h2]If you play, please use this form to give feedback![/h2]

[u][b]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdfZjqD1y935vBVS3iccytPbnuCWc-1IAWNhAYH-Lb0Szo_Fg/viewform?usp=sf_link[/b][/u]
